items.title: Finally, the Beginning of Trump’s End | The New Yorker
items.summary:
The scandal for which the second term of Donald Trump will go down in history may not have even happened yet. (Or maybe it has and we just haven’t found out about it.) But, on the eve of midterm elections whose results will shape the final two years of Trump’s tenure, it’s worth noting that, in reëlecting him in 2024, the United States created a different kind of problem for itself: a President who is himself the crisis. [...] Trump himself has been making the strongest possible case for his party’s impending defeat. If, at the beginning of this midterm campaign season, he had set out to sabotage the Republicans, he probably could not have done it better: starting an unpopular and notably unsuccessful conflict with Iran, imposing costly tariffs, and launching a trade war with Canada. All of which have driven up prices for Americans, when the signature promise of his 2024 campaign had been to curb the inflation that [...] Want better search results?
